summary: Resolver 'uiPanel_write' is registered but not invoked by any activity.
description: The 'uiPanel_write' resolver is a live capability designed for displaying UI panels to the operator. However, current telemetry shows it is invoked by 0 of the activity corpus. This gap needs to be closed by ensuring at least one substrate-authored activity successfully invokes 'uiPanel_write'. A simple way to achieve this is to modify an existing, frequently invoked activity to dispatch a 'uiPanel_write' impulse.
